full_judgment: 48. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, we are constrained to observe that the University Authority, for that matter the Syndicate members, did not act bonfire and or applied their mind in taking the impugned decision of cancellation of the results of the examinees, including the writ petitioners, in spite of the fact that the University Authority claims to be the loco parents of the students. The University authority was so unmindful to realise that by the impugned decision it attempted to ruin the family lives of the examinees concerned, in that the petitioners having had established themselves in the social life through achievements of so many years, were put to face civil death in their worldly life and that there could be hardly any "way or time for them to settle themselves again in the society after so many years. The writ petitioners, two of them are practicing as lawyers and the third petitioner Mr Faizee, while practicing in the High Court Division, was appointed as permanent Judge of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh, a noble and dream office. Because of such unmindful, inconsiderate and unkind decision of the Syndicate the said Mr Faizee has been compelled to tender resignation from the office of Judge of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court of Bangladesh and thus he has suffered irreparable loss and injury, which cannot be adequately compensated with money or otherwise. The sufferings of the petitioners are irreparable, and particularly the future of Mr Faizee has been ruined, and the Chittagong University is solely responsible for the same. We may profitably refer to a softer case in the Indian Jurisdiction in the case of Rabindra Nath Ghosal vs University of Calcutta and others, reported in All India Educational Cases (1950-91)(4) AIEC 666 wherein the publication of the result of an examinee delayed by six years has been held by the Calcutta High Court as an act of criminal neglect. We do not find any reason why, in the instant case, the decision of the Syndicate, for that matter of the Chittagong University, in canceling the results of the petitioners along with others after about 17/15 years should not be termed as an act of criminal neglect.
